rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something occurring at or forming the climax.

example.english: The climactic scene was when the protagonist returned in the rain.
example.traditional: 高潮嘅一幕係主角喺雨中返嚟。
example.jyutping: gou1 ciu4 ge3 jat1 mok6 hai6 zyu2 gok3 hai2 jyu5 zung1 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the climactic moment is being described mainly as the most suspenseful or exciting part.

example.english: At the climactic moment of the game, they scored the winning goal.
example.traditional: 場波去到最緊張嘅關頭，佢先射入致勝一球。
example.jyutping: coeng4 bo1 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3 gwaan1 tau4 keoi5 sin1 se6 jap6 zi3 sing3 jat1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when climactic emphasizes a decisive turning point rather than excitement itself.

example.english: The final vote was the climactic vote of the election and changed the result.
example.traditional: 最後嗰一票係成場選舉最關鍵嘅一票，改變咗結果。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 go2 jat1 piu3 hai6 sing4 coeng4 syun2 geoi2 zeoi3 gwaan1 gin6 ge3 jat1 piu3 goi2 bin3 zo2 git3 gwo2
